title: Claude and Indeed just joined forces and the result may have just killed recruiters
description: Claude and Indeed just joined forces and the result may have just killed recruiters. You can now connect Indeed directly to Claude and have it apply to hundreds of jobs for you. Here's how to set it up in 30 seconds: 1. Go to Claude → Customize → Connectors → Browse Connectors 2. Search for Indeed and click Add 3. Log into your account That's it. Indeed is connected. Now upload your resume and say: "Use what's on my resume. Find every job I'm qualified for that was posted in the last 7 days and rank them by how likely I am to land an interview." Claude pulls every matching job directly from Indeed. Then say: "Now apply to the top 500 jobs and tailor my application to each job description using the Google XYZ formula." Claude applies to every single one while you do absolutely nothing. Comment "Indeed" and I'll send you the full guide 👇 #ai #claude #jobsearch #indeed #career
